page.privacy.s1.title: 1. What data do we process?
page.privacy.s1.body: This site has **no account system** — no sign-up, no login. Your child's learning progress (quiz records, check-ins, points, stars, level settings and more) is stored entirely in **your device's browser local storage (localStorage)** and is never sent to any server. Clearing your browser data or using “Parents Center → Clear all data” removes it completely.
page.privacy.s2.title: 2. How do the voice features work?
page.privacy.s2.body: “Listen” playback uses the browser's built-in speech synthesis, or a public speech service proxied through a server (only the sentence you tap is sent — no identifying information). “Read-along scoring” uses the browser's speech recognition, performed by the browser's own speech service. This site **does not record or store** any audio.
page.privacy.s3.title: 3. Child protection compliance
page.privacy.s3.body: This site is designed for children: no ads, no external links, no user-generated-content inputs and no social features. Parent-related settings (level, time limit, content switches) all live in the “Parents Center” and require parent verification to enter. Processing data only on-device meets the baseline expectations of GDPR-K and COPPA for offline local processing.
page.privacy.s4.title: 4. Backup and migration
page.privacy.s4.body: You can export a learning-data backup file (JSON) from the Parents Center. The file stays on your device and is yours to keep; importing also completes entirely on-device.
page.privacy.footnote: Any updates to this policy will be published on this page. For questions, contact the maintainers via the repository Issues.
